text: Reviewed for XSS (acceptance 3): none found. Output checked for javascript:, quotes, wikilink labels, tables, code (uicode/md.mjs); CSP script-src self. But mention rewrite runs inside an href: '[x](https://a.b/(@bob)' yields href="https://a.b/(<span class=" ... garbled text with stray attributes; NUL-delimited code placeholder typed by a user renders 'undefined'. Cosmetic markup injection, no script.
